description: This file provides utility functions for configuring tooltips in ECharts visualizations within the Superset frontend. It includes functions to generate default tooltip positioning logic and label extraction based on metrics and columns.

methods.name: getDefaultTooltip
methods.description: Generates a configuration object for ECharts tooltips, including custom positioning logic that adjusts tooltip placement to prevent overflow outside the viewport.

methods.name: getTooltipLabels
methods.description: Returns an array of labels for the tooltip, derived from provided metrics and columns.
